LIP (subs.):
I Lit.:
(1) ओष्ठः (gen. = upper
l. as distinguished from अधरः = lower 1.);
(2) दशनच्छदः; दशनवासस्, etc. (poet).
II
Fig. =mouth: q. v.: मुखम्: v. Also tongue.
III Edge, as of a vessel.

LIP (v.): अधरं पिबति (पा, c. 1.) (with gen.):
v. To kiss.

LIP (adj.):
l.-salve:
ओष्ठाञ्जनम्; l.-loyalty:
मौखिकमक्तिः;
l.-honeyed:
मुखमधु (mfn.).

LIPPED: expr. by comp.,
Bimba-l.:
बिम्बोष्ठ
(f. ष्ठा).
